docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Project layout
docs.text:
mkdocs.yml    # The configuration file.
docs/
    index.md  # The documentation homepage.
    ...       # Other markdown pages, images and other files.

docs.title: Git
docs.text:
Init repo 

git init

Clone repo 

# repo dir
git clone git@github.com:user/repo.git

# current dir
git clone git@github.com:user/repo.git .

Commands bash linenums="1" hl_lines="2,5-7" git pull git add . git commit -m "Update" git commit --amend --no-edit git push git push -f git reset HEAD^ git reset --hard origin/main git diff git diff -- index.html git stash git rebase main
